detail.longDescription: Drawpile development for the last two weeks: https:// docs.drawpile.net/devblog/2026 /08/24/dev-update The Android target has been upgraded to version 16 which Google is going to make mandatory soon. This should not break compatibility with older devices because Drawpile doesn't use any new features, it's just some busywork. This is also going into Krita. You can also now convert dprec and dptxt recordings to dppr files and will be prompted on what to do when opening them. # drawpile # krita # foss # floss # opensource # devblog
